text.ja: 小型FNOの問題単位検証 u_t=\nu u_{xx},\quad x\in[0,2\pi),\quad u(x+2\pi,t)=u(x,t),\quad T=\tfrac14;\quad \widehat u_k(T)=e^{-\nu k^2T}\widehat u_k(0);\quad v^{\ell+1}=\tanh\!\left(W_\ell v^\ell+b_\ell+\mathcal F_N^{-1}(R_\ell\mathcal F_Nv^\ell)\right),\quad \ell=0,1;\quad \mathrm{relative\ error}=\frac{\operatorname{RMS}(u_\theta-u_{\rm ref})}{\operatorname{RMS}(u_{\rm ref})}\quad\text{only if }\operatorname{RMS}(u_{\rm ref})>10^{-12} 周期区間[0,2π)、uₜ=νuₓₓ、T=0.25。同じ関数の点を分散させず、全46問題を学習24・検証6・未見ID8・νのOOD4・周波数のOOD4に分けます。2固定seed、93実パラメータです。
text.en: Tiny FNO on held-out heat problems u_t=\nu u_{xx},\quad x\in[0,2\pi),\quad u(x+2\pi,t)=u(x,t),\quad T=\tfrac14;\quad \widehat u_k(T)=e^{-\nu k^2T}\widehat u_k(0);\quad v^{\ell+1}=\tanh\!\left(W_\ell v^\ell+b_\ell+\mathcal F_N^{-1}(R_\ell\mathcal F_Nv^\ell)\right),\quad \ell=0,1;\quad \mathrm{relative\ error}=\frac{\operatorname{RMS}(u_\theta-u_{\rm ref})}{\operatorname{RMS}(u_{\rm ref})}\quad\text{only if }\operatorname{RMS}(u_{\rm ref})>10^{-12} Use periodic heat flow uₜ=νuₓₓ on [0,2π) to T=0.25. Split 46 whole problems into 24 training, 6 validation, 8 held-out ID, 4 viscosity-OOD and 4 spectrum-OOD problems. Use two fixed seeds and 93 real parameters.
